// 読書リストに、表示条件と2種類の件数を追加します。
import { useState } from 'react';
import { initialBooks } from './data';
import { BookCard } from './BookCard';
import type { Book } from './types';

const filters = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'すべて' },
  { value: 'unread', label: '未読' },
  { value: 'read', label: '既読' },
] as const;

type Filter = (typeof filters)[number]['value'];

export function App() {
  const [books, setBooks] = useState<readonly Book[]>(initialBooks);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>('all');

  const visibleBooks = books.filter((book) => {
    if (filter === 'all') return true;
    return filter === 'read' ? book.read : !book.read;
  });
  const readCount = books.filter((book) => book.read).length;

  function toggle(id: string) {
    setBooks((current) =>
      current.map((book) => (book.id === id ? { ...book, read: !book.read } : book)),
    );
  }

  function reset() {
    setBooks(initialBooks);
    setFilter('all');
  }

  return (
    <section>
      <h1>読書リスト</h1>
      <div aria-label="表示条件">
        {filters.map(({ value, label }) => (
          <button
            key={value}
            id={`filter-${value}`}
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={filter === value}
            onClick={() => setFilter(value)}
          >
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p id="count">{visibleBooks.length}件</p>
      <p id="summary">既読{readCount}件 / 全{books.length}件</p>
      <ul id="books">
        {visibleBooks.map((book) => (
          <BookCard key={book.id} book={book} onToggle={toggle} />
        ))}
      </ul>
      <button id="reset" type="button" onClick={reset}>
        最初に戻す
      </button>
    </section>
  );
}
